title: Empty
description: Placeholder shown when there is no data to display.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The default icon with the "No Data" description.

svg.title: SVG illustration
svg.description: useSvg switches to the built-in illustration.

custom-icon.title: Custom icon and description
custom-icon.description: Both icon and description accept any React node.

with-action.title: With action
with-action.description: Children are rendered in the footer, e.g. a call-to-action button.

styled.title: Custom appearance
styled.description: Size and shadow have their own props; background and text colors go through style or className.

sizes.title: Title, actions and sizes
sizes.description: size switches to the unframed layout; title names the state and action / secondaryAction hold the calls to action.

EmptyProps.icon: Custom icon replacing the default one; null or false renders no icon
EmptyProps.children: Footer content, e.g. an action button
EmptyProps.useSvg: Uses the built-in SVG illustration instead of the default icon
EmptyProps.title: Heading of the empty state; also becomes its accessible name
EmptyProps.size: Switches to the unframed sized layout (small, medium or large)
